newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish shares ease 0.49 pct in weak volume.
newsitem.headline: Turkish shares ease 0.49 pct in weak volume.

text.p: Istanbul shares fell slightly in lower volume and weak sentiment on Friday due to lack of market moving expectations and liquidity inflow, brokers said.
The IMKB National-100 closed at 2,040, down 10 points, or 0.49 percent from Thursday's all-time high close of 2,050. It hit a trading record of 2,070 at the opening.
Trade volume shrank 26.7 percent to 18.29 trillion lira ($112.2 million) from Thursday's 24.95 trillion ($153 million).

Brokers said the midday funeral of bourse chairman Tuncay Artun who died on Wednesday at the age of 48, further depressed traders and officials, causing trade to become extremely sullen in the afternoon.
The second session was delayed by an hour and half because of the funeral.

"There was sadness in the market after the funeral which affected the transactions. There were also sales by players who did not want to carry their positions to Monday," said one dealer from Garanti Securities.
Some brokers said failure to pierce resistance at the index's 2,060-070 levels since the beginning of the week caused prices to revert back.
